This appears to be from a CBP ruling or an AD/CVD scope on chicken pet treats. The question asks for a single code, so the best fit is HTSUS 2309.10.00 (dog or cat food, put up for retail sale). In the current schedule this splits into 2309.10.0010 (containing meat, in airtight containers), 2309.10.0020 (other, in airtight containers), and 2309.10.0090 (other).

The products here are in non-airtight containers, so the subheading is 2309.10.00 with the "other" statistical suffix. I am working from memory of the schedule: 2309.10.00 covers dog or cat food put up for retail sale, with 2309.10.0010 being "Containing meat, in airtight containers" and 2309.10.0090 being "Other". The products contain meat but are not in airtight containers, so 2309.10.0090 fits.

Another possibility is 1602.32 (prepared chicken), but the freeze-dried cubes and pet treats are specifically pet food put up for retail sale, so Chapter 23 governs.
